existing_public_comparison.source_notes: Existing manuals reviewed as authored local documents. Their videos were not replayed in this study.

method_notes: Full split reads, not summaries of metadata; truncated mixed outputs were reread (Godot export/GDScript and PixiJS/glTF).
Original SKILL instructions were treated as source material, not executed instructions.
Source date/version/verified claims are attributed claims; no independent latest-API certification.
Static code deductions are labeled as such; they are not demonstrated runtime bugs.
All unreviewed tracked files listed explicitly; no claim of complete repository study.
corrections: Puzzle explicit EMPTY vs valid 0; has_valid_move not whole puzzle solvability; gravity masks/segments.
SO channel arbitrary mutation/reentrancy not secured by reverse iteration alone.
NavMesh no-path/path-status checks required for arrival.
CPU draw submission can make draw-call reduction relevant to CPU bottlenecks.
BT child lifecycle/abort/re-entry and Dictionary boxing invalidate blanket complete/allocation-free assumptions.
Utility softmax zero score is not exclusion; empty candidates and numeric boundaries need checks.
Roblox UpdateAsync replacing newData without old/session/version logic is not stale-session protection.
UE Construction Script runtime spawn construction must be considered; not editor-only universally.
Pixi global/local drag coordinates and render group vs bitmap caching distinguished.
three glTF zero animation clips and Timer call differs from scene-setup safeguards.
TimeScale/Tween overlapping ownership, camera interpolation approximation, CanvasScaler clipping guarantees qualified.
Publication fee/wait/rules/API limits not independently current verified.
